# L8 blind review packet

Read `review_packet.jsonl` or the 17-prompt `constraint_subset.jsonl` before opening `answer_key.json`. A, B, and C are shuffled independently per prompt. Use `corpus/metadata/l7_blind_rubric.md` for imagery, phrasing, cadence, ambiguity, contact, constraints, prose drift, coherence, and completeness. No independent human scores have been collected.
